meaning: Step 2 of REFERENCE_ENTRIES.md: task choices recorded for path A2. A profile with task_choice_required is evaluated only for the operations listed here, with this statement as the plan's task statement; results are classified 'usable with recorded task choice (step 2)' and carry the choice. status: decided by the user 2026-10-21: where the documentation leaves the reading open, follow the official PyTorch 2.10.0 source; each choice cites the retained source files (reference_program), so the corresponding results mean 'agrees with the official PyTorch implementation's reading'

choices.statement: The recorded aten._to_copy call is read as the finite dtype conversion with IEEE 754 roundTiesToEven (CAST CA.PROFILE). Decided by the user on 2026-10-21 to follow the official PyTorch 2.10.0 source, which converts to bfloat16 with detail::round_to_nearest_even (TS210_BFLOAT16_H.RNE) and to float16 with the IEEE conversion fp16_ieee_from_fp32_value (TS210_HALF_H.FROM_FP32).
choices.alternatives: another rounding direction (toward zero, stochastic) would be a different task; no FlagGems behaviour was consulted

choices.statement: Select the PyTorch 2.10 ATen avg_pool2d / avg_pool2d_backward task with the PA.DIVISOR divisor: with count_include_pad=true, the size of the window intersected with the explicit padded domain [-padding, size+padding), so a ceil-mode overhang beyond that domain is not counted; with count_include_pad=false, the number of real input positions; a nonzero divisor_override takes precedence; forward and backward use the same divisor. Decided by the user on 2026-10-21 to follow the official PyTorch 2.10.0 source: the CUDA and CPU kernels compute pool_size after clipping the window to the padded domain and before clipping it to the input (TS210_AVGPOOL2D_CU.DIVISOR, TS210_AVGPOOL_CPU.DIVISOR).
choices.alternatives: divide every window by the full kernel size (the functional page calls kernel_size the 'size of the pooling region'); or count only real input positions also with count_include_pad=true. The documentation does not settle the ceil-mode overhang; no FlagGems behaviour was consulted
